label: Medium daily digest
schedule: Every morning · Sonnet main session, local Qwen subagents

steps.title: Hermes cron starts the medium-digest skill
steps.note: The model has no file tools in this job. It can only call the server and delegate reading.

steps.title: digest_begin
steps.note: One call. The server collects Following, top picks and For you, drops what was already reported, has Jev rank every headline, and writes a run file. The model gets a compact work list of refs.
